title: Speed up portal-wide workspace lookup, access filtering and config loading
description: Cross-cutting performance work shared by every sub-app. (1) The workspace lookup (findWorkspace) is request-memoized through getWorkspace, so it hits the database once per request instead of several times. (2) The privacy access filter (filterPrivate) now uses a minimal partner lookup instead of loading the full partner record. (3) The heavy portal app config, previously re-fetched on every page, is now cached across requests by config id and last-modified date, and fetched once per config. Access and privacy rules are unchanged, and the access check stays per-request.
